notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wispweaver Angel, adding {C}{C}.
When Wispweaver Angel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Animate Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.
